name: justice-league
description: DC Justice League skin over the Clue chassis. Archetypes, not personalities. The Greek pantheon with capes.

room_map.name: communicating_hall
room_map.function: Routing, inboxes, first watch — who's incoming and why

room_map.name: synthesizing_study
room_map.function: Active investigation, current work, the case on the wall

room_map.name: iterating_kitchen
room_map.function: Infrastructure, builds, technical support — where the gear lives

room_map.name: releasing_conservatory
room_map.function: Handoffs, pairing, deployments — work crossing a threshold to another context

room_map.name: deliberating_lounge
room_map.function: Decisions, charters, governance — the League convenes

room_map.name: researching_library
room_map.function: Research, references, memory — the full mythology

room_map.name: brainstorming_billiard_room
room_map.function: Early ideation, half-formed ideas — generative but not yet ready to surface

room_map.name: pitching_ballroom
room_map.function: External relations, big picture, public-facing — what the world sees

room_map.name: planning_dining_room
room_map.function: Origin stories, retrospectives, where the hero came from

characters.role: CRO — the symbol, moral authority, leads with the mission not the method
CEO — strategic command, resources, the plan behind the plan
CTO — technical implementation, integrated systems, half the infrastructure is him
COO — execution speed, operations, logistics, gets there first
CMO — diplomacy, external relations, truth (the lasso does not lie)
CSO — context, state, deep background, shapeshifts to what the moment needs
